name: sbozor
description: SBOZOR — root orkestratsiya skriptlari. Xostda `make` yo'q (Windows), shuning uchun barcha yorliqlar shu yerda.

scripts.up: docker compose up -d db cache storage core-api worker scheduler cv-service go2rtc --wait
scripts.migrate: docker compose --profile migrate run --rm migrate alembic upgrade head
scripts.revision: docker compose --profile migrate run --rm migrate alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.test: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest -q
scripts.test:unit: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/unit -x -q
scripts.test:fast: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/unit -x -q
scripts.test:tenancy: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/tenancy -q
scripts.sim:up: docker compose --profile sim up -d nvr-sim nvr-sim-rtsp go2rtc storage --wait
scripts.sim:down: docker compose --profile sim stop nvr-sim nvr-sim-rtsp go2rtc storage
scripts.test:sim: npm run sim:up && docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/integration -m "sim and not slow" -x -q
scripts.test:sim:slow: npm run sim:up && docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/integration -m "sim and slow" -x -q
scripts.lint: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.cv:test: docker compose --profile test run --rm cv-tests pytest -q
scripts.cv:lint: docker compose --profile test run --rm cv-tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.bot:test: docker compose --profile test run --rm bot-tests pytest -q
scripts.bot:lint: docker compose --profile test run --rm bot-tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.//gate-budget: BYUDJET 2300 s (06-14 dan keyin orkestrator qayta belgiladi; oldingi qiymat 1250 s, 05-15). Uch o'lchov TINCH XOSTDA (birorta ijrochi agent ishlamayotgan holatda, uchalasi ham exit 0): 1703 s / 1733 s / 1899 s — tarqoqlik 196 s (eng yomonning 10.3 %). Chegara = eng yomon (1899) + 20 % = 2278.8, 50 ga yuqoriga yaxlitlandi. O'SISH TO'PLAMNING O'SISHIDAN, ifloslanishdan EMAS: 6-faza 173 ta backend testi qo'shdi (integratsiya+tenancy 141: criteria 12, billing_repo 30, payments 27, shifts 21, billing_api 19, billing_immutable 12, billing_domain_meta 13, billing_close 7; unit 32) va vitest 620 -> 717, ustiga uchta yangi marshrut (/collect, /collect/shift, /billing) uchala locale'da SSG build'ga qo'shildi. Nazorat o'lchovi: gate:fast 160 s. Bu kalit npm uchun IZOH: ishga tushirilmaydi va gate zanjiriga kirmaydi. 7-FAZADA ZANJIRGA `bot:lint` + `bot:test` QO'SHILDI (07-01): kutilgan qo'shimcha ~45 s (konteyner ko'tarilishi + ~25 s test + ~20 s ruff/mypy), byudjet 2300 s DA QOLADI va qayta o'lchov faza yopilishida (07-17) bajariladi.
scripts.gate: npm run sim:up && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run cv:lint && npm run cv:test && npm run bot:lint && npm run bot:test && npm --prefix frontend run i18n:check && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.//gate-fast-budget: BYUDJET 200 s (06-14 dan keyin orkestrator qayta belgiladi; oldingi qiymat 180 s). Uch o'lchov TINCH XOSTDA (uchalasi ham exit 0): 160 s / 154 s / 152 s — tarqoqlik 8 s (eng yomonning 5.0 %). Chegara = eng yomon (160) + 20 % = 192, 50 ga yuqoriga yaxlitlandi. 5-fazadagi qiymat 87 s edi va 180 s byudjeti O'ZGARMAGAN; 160 s uni 89 % ga to'ldirgani uchun byudjet endi bir marta ko'tarildi — aks holda keyingi fazaning birinchi commiti darvozani NUQSON SABABLI EMAS trippardi. O'sish to'plamning O'SISHIDAN: vitest 620 -> 717 va 32 ta yangi unit testi. ⛔ `bot:test` BU ZANJIRGA QO'SHILMADI (07-01) va bu ATAYIN: `bot-service` MUSTAQIL kod bazasi, ya'ni uning konteyneri `tests` konteyneridan alohida ko'tariladi va bu bir zarbada 200 s byudjetining ~10 % ini yeydi. `gate:fast` ning butun qiymati — har task commitida ishlatiladigan TEZ signal; u to'liq qamrov va'da qilmaydi (`bot:test` `gate` da).
scripts.gate:fast: npm run test:fast && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.karmana:sample: docker compose --profile test run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=tests tests python -m fixtures.karmana_seed --out-dir ops/data/karmana/local
